links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM antibiotic choice, dose and duration answers in special populations
links.effect: Comprehensive and correct: 38.1% pregnancy, 36.1% allergy, 27.5% older adults; error rates 11.9% pregnancy, 18.1% allergy, 25% older adults, 79.2% kidney disease, 43.8% children.
links.quote: ChatGPT produced high rates of inaccurate information for treating infectious diseases in special population.

links.outcome: Dosing errors in LLM antibiotic recommendations for kidney disease and children
links.effect: Error rate in patients with kidney disease was 79.2%; for children, 43.8% of answers contained errors.
links.quote: The error rate in patients with kidney disease was 79.2%.

links.outcome: Rate of incorrect LLM treatment recommendations needing clinician verification
links.effect: High rates of inaccurate information; error rates 11.9% to 79.2% across special populations; recommendations should be checked by healthcare professionals.
links.quote: Thus, recommendations generated by ChatGPT should be used with caution and checked by healthcare professionals to ensure accuracy and comprehensiveness prior to use.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-4 performance on queries regarding infectious disease treatment in vulnerable populations; evaluates model accuracy without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
